# Author truth, not an opening disclosure

Ivo cut the strap and lowered the clapper into the tide well. He wanted to stop a fleet whose owners ignore storm warnings, but panicked when the storm arrived early. He knows what he did; neither Mara nor the player initially does. His accusation of Mara is a defensive lie, not an alternative world truth.
